v.text: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
v.summary: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings for November 2026. The company plans a meeting with CITIC CLSA India Forum on 16 November 2026 at 10:00am IST in Mumbai via physical mode. Additionally, interactions with Morgan Stanley Asia Pacific Summit Investor Group are scheduled for 18 and 19 November 2026 at 08:30am SGT in Singapore via physical mode. The schedule is subject to change. This communication is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
